recipes.name: Thanksgiving Broccoli and Cheese Casserole
ingredients_raw: 2 (14 ounce) bags frozen broccoli florets, thawed
1.5 (10.5 ounce) cans cream of chicken soup
2 pounds processed cheese food (such as Velveeta ®), sliced
2 sleeves buttery round crackers (such as Ritz®), crushed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Place broccoli into a 9x13-inch baking dish. Drizzle 1 tablespoon melted butter over top, then add condensed soup. Stir until broccoli is coated with soup. Pack lightly to form a flat surface. Layer 1/2 of the cheese slices over broccoli mixture; set remaining cheese aside.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is bubbling, about 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and stir to blend melted cheese into the broccoli mixture. Layer with remaining cheese slices, sprinkle with crackers, and drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon melted butter.
Return to the oven and bake until cheese on top begins to melt, about 15 minutes.
Let casserole sit before serving until it thickens slightly, about 15 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Thanksgiving Broccoli and Cheese Casserole
raw_recipe.description: This five-ingredient broccoli casserole is another perfect side dish to add to your Thanksgiving meal. It's sure to be a hit with everyone at the table.

review.reviewBody: When I make this casserole, I use shredded sharp cheddar instead of Velveeta and I use more butter to drizzle over the top to make the Ritz crackers even more crispy. Always disappears. NOTE: This is good with a broccoli stir fry mix, too.

This is an update, I have made this many times and it is always a hit. I use the Velveeta reduced fat block cheese and slice about a pound up into one can of Cream of mushroom and one can of Cream of chicken. Microwave the soup cheese mix until the cheese is melted (about 2 minutes). Mix well. I microwave the broccoli florets and just mix them into the soup cheese mixture. Place in a casserole dish top with Veggie flavored crushed rounds. I use the butter to drizzle on top and bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Perfect!! Thanks for this recipe!

This is almost the exact recipe I grew up with. Still to this day I crave mom mom's broccoli and cheese casserole. The difference that we do is add 2 eggs beaten, use cream of mushroom soup, 2 tablespoons of sour cream. Cook veggies in microwave for 5... strain. Then mix it all together and bake for 35 min at 350. It is delicious!

Easy and delicious!!! I made this for 2 different Thanksgiving dinners this year. I used 1/2 Velveeta and 1/2 shredded sharp cheddar. So good! Only critique is that it is SUPER cheesy, not that anyone minds, but you could probably add another bag of broccoli if you wanted.

I made this recipe 3x this holiday season and it was a big hit! The first time I made it exactly as the recipe stated, but my husband thought it was too cheesy and suggested I add more broccoli next time. The second and third time I did add more broccoli using the same size dish (9x11) but didn't measure what I added. I mixed it with family sized can of 98% fat free cream of mushroom instead (I bought the wrong soup!). I also used 1lb of Velveeta instead of 2 lbs and I did not add the cracker topping. It came out great each time I made it and everyone wanted the recipe. I will be making this over and over again..thank you for sharing :)
I loved it . I added a bag of ritz crackers and baked. Then stirred and added another bag baked then took out and stirred. It was delicious

My kids, nor myself eat broccoli but my cousin brought this over and it was a hit. Not one bite left. I made it last night and once again, not one bite left. To the reader asking about adding water, No I just melted the cheese, cream of chicken soup and butter together and then poured over the broccoli and threw it in the over. I used garlic flavored ritz style cracker because that is all I had. This has to be the easiest dish next to green bean casserole. Good luck and enjoy
Very simple and very good, I used shredded sharp cheddar.

This recipe was really easy and delicious. The only thing I will change the next time is I will use 3 bags of broccoli instead of 2. It makes a lot of cheese sauce, there's almost more sauce than broccoli.

Definite winner! I made exactly as recipe said, I dislike people who change it before trying the OG recipe. Next time I will use less Velveeta or more broccoli. Or I might switch out the broccoli for cauliflower, a bit less ⛽️ 😇. Yes, I will keep using Velveeta, I only use it at xmas! Fyi, super easy, yes I get not the healthiest, so yummy!

Happy Thanksgiving y'all.... I was searching for a different recipe for this dish rather than the one I had made for years, just for something different. This was one of the dishes I was assigned to bring to our dinner today. After choosing this one I made a trial run of it for dinner last night. Everyone loved it!! Even my 2 yr old Granddaughter who as everyone knows 2yr olds don't like many veggies lol. The only things I changed was I used Chopped Broccoli (easier for my Granddaughter to eat) & the topping. My family loves the Durky Dried Onions so I topped it with those instead and spritzed them with a little butter . Perfect!! Tysm for sharing this quick & simple recipe !!
I really liked this recipe. Took it to a family dinner and everyone like it.
It was so easy to make and was so delicious to eat! The pan went so fast for Thanksgiving that I'm doubling the recipe for Christmas!
Was so good only a little left after dinner that I had for lunch but left me wanting more. will make again.

I made this last night for Thanksgiving. It was good but not a keeper for me. I agree with some other reviews that some cheddar cheese might’ve made it better. It was just ok. It was a little too cheesy. I didn’t think that could be a thing! Ha!
Way too much cheese.
It seemed simple and easy enough to try so I did. I didn't have any cream of chicken on hand so substituting cream of celery. Still in the over, will let you know how it turns out.
This is my husband's favorite dish! I have been making it for Thanksgiving and Christmas for the past 3 years. In fact, I have to double the recipe because it keeps disappearing on the first day!
Turned out good just a bit too much cheese. Will try mixing with cheddar next time.
So yummy and creamy! My husband has me make this almost every week!
